name: Employer-Sponsored Work Permit

requirements.blocker_text: The employer must demonstrate to the Ministry of Labour and Social Security that the position cannot be adequately filled by a Burkinabe national (a labor-market test), and submit the foreign applicant's passport, job description, qualifications, employment contract, company registration documents, compliance proof, and a medical certificate. Ministry review runs 4-8 weeks; the full process (sponsorship plus visa) runs roughly 8-14 weeks. Permits typically run up to 1 year.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from a Burkinabe employer willing to justify the hire against the labor-market test, and have the employer file with the Ministry of Labour.
